financial_statements_and_notes.notes:
[chunk 3/3] This section (Note 10 Segment Information + tax notes) is primarily operational/segment data with no named SPVs, VIEs, or private equity investment counterparties disclosed. Key SIFI-material extractions:

1. CAPEX_ROI_GAP (severity 4): AWS alone added $96.5B in PP&E in FY2025 — 75% of its $128.7B annual revenue — with no disclosed contracted revenue commitments to backstop this spend. Consolidated capex of $142.4B is 20% of total net sales. The AWS PP&E balance ballooned from $110.7B → $190.1B in one year.

2. EXECUTION_RISK (severity 3): Build-to-suit lease additions surged to $421M (AWS) in 2025 vs near-zero prior years, indicating large new facilities under construction.

3. HIDDEN_LEVERAGE (severity 3): Finance lease additions jumped to ~$2.9B combined in 2025 vs $854M in 2024 — a 3.4x surge — indicating accelerating off-P&L obligations for compute infrastructure.

4. Tax contingencies in Luxembourg and India are material but unquantified; adverse resolution could be SIFI-material.

5. Equity-method investment losses of $554M in 2025 (vs $101M in 2024) suggest worsening performance in equity-method investees — possible signal for Anthropic or other named investments covered elsewhere in the filing.

No named AI lab counterparties, SPVs, or investment roster appear in this section — those would appear in the investment notes (e.g., Note 8 or related-party disclosures) not extracted here.
